stem: Unwanted or excessive loud sound from traffic, loudspeakers, and industrial machinery, which can cause hearing damage, stress, and sleep disturbance in humans, is classified as:
explanation: Noise pollution refers specifically to harmful or excessive sound levels in the environment — measured in decibels (dB) — distinct from air pollution (harmful gases/particulates) or thermal pollution (excessive heat discharged into water bodies).
